description: Hand-written scripted replies for the idea-pipeline E2E (Step 3 Wave 2, N5) on the step3_ideas/repo fixture: obvious is S1's reply, lanes the six lens replies and the leap's, review the reviewer's reply for E3-J (ids as the pipeline numbers them for run e3-j), edits the editor's str_replace turns per hypothesis title (an empty list: the editor changes nothing). Per idea: Track seen values in a set (O1) keeps; Accumulate the totals (O2, initial=0) fails the suite; Return the sorted distinct values and Count the buckets over the distinct values change the output; Build the distinct values with dict.fromkeys keeps; Look values up in a bitmap quotes nothing in the file; Import the abstract types lazily quotes the module header; Memoise the bucket bounds anchors in bucket_bounds, under 1 % of the profile; the reviewer removes Index the result with a dict (duplicate_of obvious-01) and Skip the scan when the input has no repeats (precondition_false).

obvious.title: Track seen values in a set
obvious.change_summary: Keep a set of the values already emitted beside the result list and test membership against the set instead of scanning the list.
obvious.justification_summary: unique_in_order scans the result list through contains once per item, so the loop is quadratic in the input size.
obvious.equivalence_summary: the result list is built in the same order from the same first occurrences

obvious.title: Accumulate the totals with itertools.accumulate
obvious.change_summary: Replace the loop in running_totals with itertools.accumulate over the values.
obvious.justification_summary: running_totals adds the values in a Python loop; accumulate does it in C.
obvious.precondition: the values are integers, so the sums are exact
obvious.equivalence_summary: accumulate yields the same prefix sums in the same order

eliminate.title: Build the distinct values with dict.fromkeys
eliminate.change_summary: In summarise take the distinct values from dict.fromkeys(items) instead of calling unique_in_order.
eliminate.justification_summary: A dict keeps the first occurrence of each key in insertion order, so one hashed pass replaces the per-item scan of the result list.
eliminate.equivalence_summary: dict keys keep insertion order, so the same values come out in the same order

assume_less.title: Memoise the bucket bounds
assume_less.change_summary: Cache bucket_bounds' list per (limit, buckets) pair.
assume_less.justification_summary: bucket_bounds rebuilds the same bounds on every run.
assume_less.precondition: the limit and the bucket count repeat across calls

assume_less.title: Look values up in a bitmap
assume_less.change_summary: Mark emitted values in a bytearray indexed by value.
assume_less.justification_summary: A bitmap probe is cheaper than a hash probe for small integers.
assume_less.precondition: the values are small non-negative integers
assume_less.equivalence_summary: the same values are emitted in the same order

name_the_problem.title: Return the sorted distinct values
name_the_problem.change_summary: Build the distinct values with set() and return them sorted, dropping the scan.
name_the_problem.justification_summary: A set build and one sort are O(n log n) where the scan is quadratic.
name_the_problem.depends_on_quote:
for item in items:
        if not contains(result, item):
name_the_problem.precondition: callers only need each value once
name_the_problem.equivalence_summary: the same distinct values are returned

recombine.title: Count the buckets over the distinct values
recombine.change_summary: Sort and count the distinct values instead of every item.
recombine.justification_summary: summarise sorts and counts all 12,000 items when 7,578 distinct values cover the same range.
recombine.depends_on_quote:
for item in sorted(items):
        while item >= bounds[bucket + 1]:
recombine.precondition: repeated values do not change which buckets are filled
recombine.equivalence_summary: every bucket that holds a value still holds one

resolve_tradeoff.title: Import the abstract types lazily
resolve_tradeoff.change_summary: Move the collections.abc import under TYPE_CHECKING.
resolve_tradeoff.justification_summary: The module imports its annotation types on every run.
resolve_tradeoff.precondition: the types are only used in annotations
resolve_tradeoff.equivalence_summary: the functions run the same code

far.title: Index the result with a dict
far.change_summary: Keep the emitted values as keys of a dict and return its keys as a list.
far.justification_summary: A dict lookup replaces the scan of the result list in contains.
far.equivalence_summary: dict keys keep insertion order, so the order is the same

leap.title: Skip the scan when the input has no repeats
leap.change_summary: Check len(set(items)) == len(items) first and return the items as a list when they hold no repeats.
leap.justification_summary: Inputs without repeats need no membership tests at all.
leap.depends_on_quote:
for item in items:
        if not contains(result, item):
leap.precondition: the workload's input usually holds no repeated values
leap.equivalence_summary: an input without repeats is its own de-duplication

review.change_plan: In unique_in_order keep a set of emitted values and test it instead of calling contains.
In running_totals return the accumulated sums of the values.
In unique_in_order return the sorted set of the items.
In summarise sort and count the distinct values.
In summarise build unique as list(dict.fromkeys(items)).
